title: Finite type descends along faithfully flat ring maps (Stacks 00QP)
statement: Let $\rho:R\to R'$ be a faithfully flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map], let $\alpha:R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, and let $A'=R'\otimes_RA$, an $R'$-algebra through $r'\mapsto r'\otimes1$. Then $A$ is a finite type $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] if and only if $A'$ is a finite type $R'$-algebra.
